title: Diaterpenylic acid acetate (DTAA): characterization and OH oxidation in atmospheric chambers
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00086F, Paper

Kalliopi Florou, Spiro Jorga, Agata Blaziak, Christina N. Vasilakopoulou, Petro Uruci, Rafal Szmigielski, Spyros N. Pandis
DTAA can be viewed as a model later-generation product of monoterpene ozonolysis, a major source of secondary organic aerosol. This paper shows that DTAA is semivolatile and continues reacting with OH, producing even later-generation products.
